I replied to Kwame in your DM thread, so he knows where things stand.

I did not set up the recurring 09:00 digest. I told him I can't schedule a DM from here. I'm not certain of that: my scheduler is local-only and wouldn't deliver to Slack, but I didn't check whether the world tools offer a scheduled-post option. If you want the recurring digest, someone with access to the scheduling side will need to set it up. I offered Kwame an on-demand version: he DMs "digest" and I summarise #coastal-team since his last one. Kwame is a member of #coastal-team, so that's within what he can see.
